title: Wrong Side Driving Car Game
desc: Wrong Side Driving is a fast-paced endless driving game where you take the ultimate risk &mdash; driving on the wrong side of the road! Dodge oncoming traffic, collect power-ups, and test your reflexes as the speed increases with every passing second. One mistake and it&rsquo;s game over with a big crash explosion! Perfect for both casual players and thrill-seekers, this game guarantees endless fun and excitement.
howto: Tap Let Right or Use Arrow Keys to control
tips: Read the next obstacle early before making a move.
Use small, steady inputs instead of overcorrecting.
Restart quickly and learn the pattern one attempt at a time.
